confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Belfast price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than July hostel and hotel rates, which depend on peak-season demand. Sterling was converted at an assumed GBP/USD near 1.34, not a live rate. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.2x).
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized UK regional cities with similar summer tourism demand (e.g., Glasgow, Cardiff, Liverpool), positioned below London and Edinburgh; accommodation reflects July peak-season pricing.
